Also to be considered is the requirement for back volume in
both cases. Dynamic speakers typically require a substantial
back volume to achieve the optimum frequency response.
One option is to provide a vent in the housing to the open
air, though this may not be preferred for devices meant for
outdoor use in all weather. The other option is to provide the
back volume within the enclosure. A typical back volume for
a 6mm dynamic speaker would be about the same as the
driver volume itself, or roughly 100 mm3. In contrast, one
can use an unvented balanced armature driver that requires
no external back volume at all. Unvented drivers provide a
balanced acoustic signature especially suitable for voice
applications as well as music.
